items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I always did their hurdles for the Gary Moore show which was the date show that I was doing, the main show.

ctx.x: What about the Penny Paige Show?
I did you do that show. I think she appeared on the Gary Moore show once or twice. But, I think she had her show of her own. I think she was on ABC, or NBC. I'm not sure.
